ref2va_prompt_template_en.subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the user's real household pet in <Picture 1>. <Picture 1> is the sole identity source for the pet's visible species and breed traits, face shape, eyes, ears, coat colors and markings, tail, body proportions, age impression, and any existing collar or clothing.
<Subject 2> is the home environment in <Picture 2>. <Picture 2> is the sole reference for the scene layout, structures, furnishings, surfaces, materials, lighting direction, perspective, safe activity area, props, and 16:9 composition.
ref2va_prompt_template_en.summary: [reference generation] The target video is an exactly {duration}-second seamless photorealistic live desktop wallpaper showing <Subject 1> making one small, low-risk movement cycle inside <Subject 2>. The pet identity from <Picture 1> and the complete environment from <Picture 2> remain fully consistent in one locked-off shot. The frame at 8.00 seconds must visually match the frame at 0.00 seconds.
ref2va_prompt_template_en.retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the pet's exact visible identity, species and breed traits, face, eyes, ears, coat colors and markings, tail, body proportions, age impression, existing accessories, anatomy, scale, and ground contact without redesign, duplication, identity drift, or intersection with the environment.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the referenced room or outdoor-home layout, architecture, furniture, props, materials, perspective, lighting, shadows, safe boundaries, and 16:9 composition without replacement, relocation, deformation, moving props, or added people or animals. The complete scene state at 8.00 seconds matches 0.00 seconds.
ref2va_prompt_template_en.detailed_description:
The target video is one uninterrupted, photorealistic, locked-off 16:9 shot lasting exactly {duration} seconds.
[Shot 1] Reproduce <Subject 2> from <Picture 2> with unchanged camera position, perspective, layout, textures, prop placement, lighting, and shadows. {setting_notes} {safe_zone} Every surface, piece of furniture, tunnel, toy, plant, fence, and decoration is a solid collision boundary and remains static.
Place <Subject 1> from <Picture 1> at believable scale on the visible ground plane. Preserve its face, eyes, ears, coat colors and pattern boundaries, tail, proportions, age impression, and existing accessories. Keep stable anatomy, correct limb count, planted paws or feet, realistic weight, and a matching contact shadow. No body part may intersect, enter, pass behind, merge with, or emerge from any object. Maintain a clearly visible air gap from every prop.
At exactly 0.00 seconds, establish this loop anchor: {loop_pose} From 0.00 to 1.00 seconds, hold the anchor with only subtle breathing and one blink. From 1.00 to 4.50 seconds, perform this low-collision action: {action} Keep the motion slow, species-appropriate, and fully visible; no jump, pounce, spin, tunnel entry, furniture occlusion, or object contact. From 4.50 to 7.00 seconds, reverse the same short route in the opposite order and at the same pace. Replant each paw or foot on its previous position, undo the head movement, and restore the opening orientation without teleporting or sliding. From 7.00 to 8.00 seconds, hold the opening anchor again with the same breathing and blink state.
At exactly 8.00 seconds, the final frame must match the 0.00-second frame: identical pet coordinates, scale, silhouette, joints, paw placement, head, gaze, ears, tail, coat pattern, contact shadow, camera, crop, focus, props, lighting, reflections, particles, and background. Keep the camera perfectly locked with no cut, zoom, pan, tilt, roll, shake, reframing, lens breathing, or focus pumping. Add no people, animals, duplicate pet, accessories, furniture, or objects. Prevent identity drift, morphing, clipping, penetration, extra or fused limbs, floating paws, scale changes, texture crawling, warping, flicker, text, logos, and watermarks. {extra_direction}
ref2va_prompt_template_en.overall_soundscape: Extremely subtle scene-appropriate room tone or outdoor ambience continues at a constant level, with only quiet synchronized footsteps and breathing. No toy-contact sounds, voices, speech, barking, meowing, loud impacts, or distracting effects. The ambience at 8.00 seconds matches 0.00 seconds.
